what: is the readback the base data under a transform or a shift
reading: No distinctive base frame appears anywhere in the readback stream under any of the transforms tried, at any offset. The readback is not the configuration data misordered or displaced; whatever it is, it is not this bitstream rearranged.

readback_all_zero.note: an all-zero frame is trivially consistent

frame_ecc.reading: Configuration frames carry a computed ECC. The bitstream satisfies it everywhere; the readback satisfies it in 1.9% of its non-zero frames. Whatever the readback returns in this state, most of it is not frame-shaped.
